title: Senegal at the World Cup
description: From beating France on debut to winning the AFCON — the Lions of Teranga have made their mark on world football.

questions.q: In which year did Senegal make a stunning World Cup debut?
questions.explain: Senegal made their World Cup debut at the 2002 tournament in South Korea and Japan — and they made it memorable by beating the reigning champions France in their very first match.

questions.q: Senegal beat defending champions France 1–0 in their 2002 World Cup debut. Who scored the only goal?
questions.explain: Papa Bouba Diop — nicknamed 'The Wardrobe' for his imposing physique — scored the goal. His celebration, where teammates waved shirts around the corner flag, became one of the tournament's iconic moments.

questions.q: How far did Senegal reach at the 2002 World Cup on their debut?
questions.explain: Senegal reached the quarter-finals on their debut — beating Sweden 2–1 in the round of 16 with a golden goal by Henri Camara, before losing 1–0 to Turkey in the quarter-final.

questions.q: Senegal won the Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) for the first time in which year?
questions.explain: Senegal won their first AFCON title at the 2021 tournament (held in January 2022), beating Egypt on penalties in the final. Sadio Mané — who had missed the decisive penalty at the 2019 AFCON final — this time scored the winning spot-kick.

questions.q: Who is Senegal's most famous modern player — a Liverpool and Bayern Munich forward who led them to AFCON glory?
questions.explain: Sadio Mané won the Premier League with Liverpool, scored the winning penalty in the 2022 AFCON final and is Senegal's all-time top scorer. He moved to Bayern Munich in 2022.

questions.q: Senegal's coach who guided them to the 2022 AFCON and 2022 World Cup was a member of the 2002 World Cup squad. Who is he?
questions.explain: Aliou Cissé captained Senegal in 2002 and later became their manager, guiding them to both the AFCON and the 2022 World Cup. It's a remarkable story of continuity for Senegalese football.

questions.q: At the 2022 World Cup, Senegal reached the round of 16. Which team knocked them out?
questions.explain: England beat Senegal 3–0 in the round of 16, with goals from Jordan Henderson, Harry Kane and Bukayo Saka. Sadio Mané was missing injured for much of the tournament.

questions.q: Senegal are sometimes called Africa's best team. How many times have they qualified for the World Cup?
questions.explain: As of 2026, Senegal have qualified for the World Cup three times — 2002 (QF), 2018 (group stage) and 2022 (R16). They missed 2006, 2010 and 2014.

questions.q: Which Senegalese player was controversially sent off and banned from playing for West Ham after the 2002 World Cup?
questions.explain: El-Hadji Diouf was involved in a spitting incident during the 2002 World Cup and was later banned. His World Cup performances were brilliant — his off-field behaviour was not.

questions.q: What is the nickname of the Senegal national football team?
questions.explain: Senegal are known as the Lions of Teranga — 'Teranga' meaning 'hospitality' in Wolof, reflecting the famous warmth and generosity of Senegalese culture.
